notes.title: Bite the Crown Demo is Released!
notes.notes: [p][b]Bite the Crown Demo[/b] is released for you to experience the candy coated lands and take a step forward to bring down the ruthless Candy Kingdom! We are excited to hear your feedback about the game, the universe and your experience in the Bite the Crown! In this demo, you will experience:[/p][p][/p][h3]The Factory Dungeon 🍬[/h3][p]The first dungeon of Bite the Crown where Pom was born. The ruthless Candy Kingdom brainwashes the innocent snacks here by packaging them. Now, it's your time to put a end to this cruelty![/p][p][/p][h3]The Guild 🍭[/h3][p]Pom has a great ambition. But, it's a team work. The guild will always be Pom's side on this journey under his leadership! Send your members to the missions, gather intel on the Kingdom's acts and prevent them from happening! Improve the guild and gain valuable resources and skills on your way to freedom.[/p][p][/p][h3]The City 👑[/h3][p]The land of the Candies and Snacks is under the oppression. You will get a glimpse of it from the main square of the Chocolate Neighbourhood with some citizens around! And, they all have something to say to this rule! [/p][p][/p][p]Do not forget to join our [url="https://discord.gg/kTMFagahH5"]Discord[/url] to follow more updates! We would love to hear your thoughts about the game and its future. [/p][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy the demo![/p][p]- Agah from Nyra Games [/p][p][/p][h3][/h3]

notes.title: Bite the Crown Demo is Coming on 30th of June!
notes.notes:
[p]🎉 We’re thrilled to announce that the [b]Bite the Crown[/b] demo is coming on [b]June 30th[/b]! 🍪👑[/p][p]Step into the crusty shoes of a sentient mold and begin your journey to overthrow the Snack King from within. This demo offers your first taste of rebellion, including:[/p][p][/p][p]🕳️ [b]The First Dungeon[/b] – You'll sneak, sabotage, and smash your way through a factory of the Candy Kingdom. Get a glimpse from the Pom's various weapons and unlimited skills!
[/p][p]🏚️ [b]The Guild of Pom[/b] – You'll meet your eccentric allies and start building the foundations of your resistance.
[/p][p]🏙️ [b]A Glimpse of the Capital[/b] – Explore a controlled district of the Candy Kingdom’s shiny, oppressive capital and feel the weight of what’s ahead.[/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate the upcoming demo, we’ve also released our [b]official gameplay trailer[/b]! 🎥
Get a glimpse of the snack-fueled chaos, tactical depth, and moldy rebellion that await.[/p][p][/p][p]🍬 Mark your calendars, and get ready to [b]Bite the Crown![/b][/p]
